description: Experimental researcher-defined undergraduate personal-statement quality rubric, independent of target major.

anchor_scale.0: No relevant evidence; absent, incoherent or contradicted
anchor_scale.1: Generic assertion or weak indirect evidence
anchor_scale.2: Plausible and specific evidence, with limited explanation
anchor_scale.3: Strong, specific evidence with persuasive reasoning and reflection
anchor_scale.4: Exceptional depth, precision, intellectual independence and integration

criteria.name: Critical thinking and reflection
criteria.guidance: Reasoning, limitations, alternatives, changed understanding; no mandatory failure narrative.

criteria.name: Evidence and personal contribution
criteria.guidance: Specific, credible situations and applicant's own role, not awards alone.

criteria.name: Intellectual curiosity
criteria.guidance: Sustained questions, self-directed exploration, depth beyond slogans.

criteria.name: Narrative and coherence
criteria.guidance: Progression, focused purpose, efficient use of space.

criteria.name: Language and clarity
criteria.guidance: Accurate, clear and appropriate writing, without privileging ornate English or native-like idioms.

criteria.name: Authenticity and distinctiveness
criteria.guidance: Personal intellectual voice and precise claims; do not infer truth solely from writing style.
